inert_mixed_reference_file.format: JSONL, one reference dict per line

row_order: scene order000000,000001,000002,000005,000006; within each scene original JSON frame keys sorted int; frame_index increments across all230 frames; within frame obj1 GT list indices retain original ascending enumerate order; within instance native_slot0..7

schema_from_producer_code.reference_xy: float[2]: projected original full-frame pixel x,y
schema_from_producer_code.reference_point_uncertainty: str: nominalCAD/providedpose low-centimeter approximate, not physicalpixelgold
schema_from_producer_code.pose_diagnostics: dict: finiteR/t, orthogonality, determinant, inverse difference, provided_values_unchanged

mapping.basis: Choose max outward-normal cosine among four vertical cuboid faces using provided camera position. Top/bottom uses object+Z; front top left/right uses projected imageX; rear follows fixed depth-edge correspondence.
mapping.internal_nearest_operations: Only fixed-cuboid geometric top/bottom and rear neighbor pairing; no original q is an argument.
mapping.writer_authority: Empirically verified renderer-equivalent rule copied by AST, not recovered original writer; exact tie policy uncertified.

raw_HW.coordinate_order: reference_xy x,y in original fullframe; raw_hw H,W
raw_HW.code_basis: Producer declared expected shape from prior fixed10; seal says all230 actual RGB shapes checked separately. No new image shape/decode verification in this task.

centroid_note: NATIVE_NAMES includes a ninth centroid name, but this writer loops range(8). ALL2424 has no centroid row; centroids are a separate ALL303_PROJECTED_CENTROIDS_GT_ONLY.jsonl pointer, not opened.

future_selective_join.required_authority: Exact approved TRAIN row-ID whitelist plus fixed selected_gt_instance_index and role_correspondence_supported; do not select nearest/best candidate.
future_selective_join.retain: Original q/L/native/U unchanged; keep missing instance, unsupported correspondence, OOF/nonpositiveZ reference as explicit UNKNOWN/diagnostic, not E.
future_selective_join.mixed_body_access: Requires a separate root actual scope; this preparation does not open/stat/hash mixed reference JSONL. Predeclare selected keys/ordinals and ensure excluded validation records are not semantically parsed.
future_selective_join.distance_authority: q-reference delta is nominal-reference alignment diagnostic, not certified coordinate error or new coordinate-quality target.
